#### Quick Tips for Vegetarian Dining at These Restaurants

1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan” versions** – Many dishes can be made vegetarian by simply omitting meat or seafood.  
2. **Look for “Pad Thai” or “Pad Krapow”** – These are usually vegetarian-friendly if you request no shrimp or chicken.  
3. **Check the menu online** – Most of these restaurants post their menus on their websites or on Google Maps, so you can see vegetarian options before you go.  
4. **Call ahead** – If you’re planning a large group or have dietary restrictions, it’s a good idea to call and confirm that vegetarian options are available and that they can accommodate your needs.  

Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
